stories.H1: Harness vendor wants to swap the 'umbilical' cable jacket from TPE to PVC; posted in supply-chain, harness is in DVT so the alt material needs an ECO approved by Tom.
stories.H2: Wrist absolute encoder ('mag puck', AS5048A) is not on the roster but Priya does all the work on it: zero drift question to Ravi goes unanswered for days, and a supplier NRND notice needs to reach Priya, not the 'wrist' owner.
stories.H3: Wrist motor bracket tweak is fine while wrist is in EVT; wrist moves to DVT on day 12, then a weekend bracket rev needs an ECO and blocks Mei's wrist PO.

messages.text: kestrel (harness house) says the TPE jacket compound for the arm umbilical is on allocation til nov. they're proposing PVC jacket for the DVT lot, same OD. need an eng yes/no by thurs or they bump us in the queue
<@U_MEI> just seeing this, PVC is a no for the elbow section. way stiffer + cracks in flex when cold. do they have any other TPE?
they can do a santoprene TPE alt, same 85A durometer, no slip on the lot. but thats a material change on a DVT drawing so it needs an ECO right?
yes. Priya pls send the ECO w/ the datasheet, I'll approve if flex data looks ok
ECO-031 submitted <@U_TOM>. kestrel's sample of the alt jacket did 10k flex cycles on the bench, no cracking
ECO-031 approved ✅ Mei go ahead w/ kestrel on the santoprene jacket
wrist abs encoder (the mag puck) zero offset drifts ~1.5deg after every thermal cycle. smells like the magnet creeping in the shaft bore. adding re-zero on boot to the cal routine for now
<@U_RAVI> q for you: is the magnet pressed or glued into the wrist shaft? and whats the bore tol? need to know if this is a mech fix or I just live with re-zero in fw
bump <@U_RAVI> - need this before the wrist goes to DVT. re-zero on boot adds ~2s to startup which I'd rather not ship
sorry missed this, was heads down on harness stuff. glued (loctite 638), bore is H7. shouldnt creep unless the glue didnt cure, I'll pull one apart mon. if it's a shaft change it's an ECO now 😬
fyi ams osram flagged AS5048A (the wrist mag encoder) as NRND. still buyable thru 2027 but they recommend AS5047P for new designs. who owns this one?
that's me. 5047P is footprint compatible, diff SPI framing. I'll roll it into the driver board respin, no action for DVT qty
tweaking the wrist mtr mount: +2 fins and a thermal pad pocket under the can now that the new driver runs cooler. bracket rev E in PDM, no fit change
<!channel> TMC9660 boards passed validation (thermals + 500 cycle run clean, thx Priya). wrist moves to DVT as of today, so all 3 subsystems are DVT now. any wrist changes from here on need an ECO
👍 releasing the wrist POs mon, bracket at rev E
one more - moved the pad pocket 2mm to clear the J4 crimps, pushed rev F
<@U_RAVI> wrist is DVT now, rev F needs an ECO. <@U_MEI> pls hold the bracket PO until it's approved
who left scope probes in the kitchen 😂
guilty
printer jammed again. anyone know where the spare 0.4 nozzles went?
top shelf blue bin
anyone watching the race tmrw? 🏎️
